import heapq


class Helpdesk:
    PRIORITIES = ("normal", "high", "critical")

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._customers = {}
        self._tickets = {}
        self._queue = []
        self._next_id = 1

    def add_customer(self, name: str, vip: bool = False) -> None:
        self._customers[name] = vip

    def open_ticket(
        self, customer: str, title: str, priority: str = "normal"
    ) -> int:
        """Open a ticket; returns its id."""
        if not title:
            raise ValueError("Ticket title cannot be empty")
        if priority not in self.PRIORITIES:
            raise ValueError("Invalid priority")
        vip = self._customers[customer]

        ticket_id = self._next_id
        self._next_id += 1
        self._tickets[ticket_id] = {
            "customer": customer,
            "title": title,
            "priority": priority,
            "vip": vip,
            "closed": False,
            "queued": False,
            "generation": 0,
        }
        self._enqueue(ticket_id)
        return ticket_id

    def _enqueue(self, ticket_id: int) -> None:
        ticket = self._tickets[ticket_id]
        ticket["queued"] = True
        ticket["generation"] += 1
        heapq.heappush(
            self._queue,
            (
                not ticket["vip"],
                -self.PRIORITIES.index(ticket["priority"]),
                ticket_id,
                ticket["generation"],
            ),
        )

    def next_ticket(self) -> int | None:
        """Take the next ticket out of the queue, or return None."""
        while self._queue:
            _, _, ticket_id, generation = heapq.heappop(self._queue)
            ticket = self._tickets[ticket_id]
            if (
                ticket["queued"]
                and not ticket["closed"]
                and ticket["generation"] == generation
            ):
                ticket["queued"] = False
                return ticket_id
        return None

    def close(self, ticket_id: int) -> None:
        ticket = self._tickets[ticket_id]
        ticket["closed"] = True
        ticket["queued"] = False

    def reopen(self, ticket_id: int) -> None:
        """Put a ticket back into the queue."""
        ticket = self._tickets[ticket_id]
        if ticket["closed"]:
            raise ValueError("Cannot reopen a closed ticket")
        if not ticket["queued"]:
            self._enqueue(ticket_id)
